oneLine: Kuku Technologies receives SEBI approval for IPO and UDRHP filing.

sources.title: Kuku Technologies IPO receives SEBI approval, allowed to file UDRHP

synopsis: Kuku Technologies, a digital content and entertainment company founded in 2018 by Lal Chand Bisu, Vinod Kumar Meena, and Vikas Goyal, has received SEBI approval to proceed with its IPO plans following a confidential draft filing in June 2026. The public issue is expected to raise between Rs 2,500 and 3,500 crore, comprising both a fresh issue of shares and an offer-for-sale (OFS) component. Following the approval, the company has an 18-month window to launch the IPO, which will begin with the filing of an updated draft red herring prospectus (UDRHP). The company previously appointed Kotak Mahindra Capital Company, Jefferies India, JM Financial, and Axis Capital as bankers for the IPO.
